```{r}
# devtools::load_all()
library(CC2)
source('directorySet.R')
```

Here, I want to just process the ANAEs into each breeding polygon

The breeding polygons aren't exported by eFlowEval, but are created by [their own notebook](waterbird_breeding_polys.qmd). So load them in.

```{r}
breeding_polys <- readRDS(file.path(datOut, 'waterbird_breeding', 'breeding_polys.rds'))

```

```{r}
system.time(
  process_anae(datIn = datDir, 
             outDir = file.path(datOut, 'ANAEbirdbreed'),
                        outname = 'ANAEbirdbreed',
                        intersections = breeding_polys,
                        commonCRS = 3577,
                        chunksave = 'Wetland')
)

```
